2750.def:

| where (FileName in~ ("amsdk.sys", "wsftprm.sys", "bootrepair.sys", "enportv.sys", "pdfcore8.dll", "converttopdf.exe", "pdfdirect.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("amsdk.sys", "wsftprm.sys", "bootrepair.sys", "enportv.sys", "pdfcore8.dll", "converttopdf.exe", "pdfdirect.exe"))

id: d5b3e4f6-7a8c-4d9e-0f1b-2c3d4e5f6071
status: experimental
description: Detects a shell, downloader or interpreter writing into /app inside the Ruflo container - the persistence action of CVE-2026-59726.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/ruflo-mcp-flaw-lets-unauthenticated.html
  - https://noma.security/blog/rufroot-the-mcp-bridge-vulnerability-that-turns-agents-into-rogue-admins-cve-2026-59726/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/01
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.persistence
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith: '/app/'
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/ash'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/tee'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate deploy/entrypoint scripts writing config into /app at container start
level: high
2793.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="/app/*" (Filesystem.action=created OR Filesystem.action=modified OR Filesystem.action=renamed) by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name, Filesystem.action, Filesystem.process_guid
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| sort - lastTime
2793.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/^\/app\//i
| ContextImageFileName=/\/(sh|bash|dash|ash|zsh|curl|wget|tee|python[0-9]?|perl|nc|ncat)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2794.sigma:
title: Non-Loopback Inbound to Ruflo MCP Bridge 3001 or MongoDB 27017
id: e6c4f5a7-8b9d-4e0f-1a2b-3c4d5e6f7082
status: experimental
description: Detects remote (non-loopback) connections to the Ruflo MCP bridge (3001) or MongoDB (27017), the exposure exploited by CVE-2026-59726.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/ruflo-mcp-flaw-lets-unauthenticated.html
  - https://noma.security/blog/rufroot-the-mcp-bridge-vulnerability-that-turns-agents-into-rogue-admins-cve-2026-59726/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/01
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationPort:
      - 3001
      - 27017
  filter_loopback:
    SourceIp|startswith:
      - '127.'
      - '::1'
  condition: selection and not filter_loopback
falsepositives:
  - Internal application tiers or reverse proxies legitimately reaching the bridge on an internal network
level: medium
2794.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_port=3001 OR All_Traffic.dest_port=27017) All_Traffic.direction=inbound by All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.dest, All_Traffic.dest_port, All_Traffic.transport
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| where NOT cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8",src) AND NOT cidrmatch("::1/128",src)
| sort - lastTime
2794.falcon:
#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 (LocalPort=3001 OR LocalPort=27017)
| NOT cidr("127.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, LocalPort, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=count())
2794.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/vpc/flowlogs
fields @timestamp, srcAddr, dstAddr, dstPort, srcPort, action, protocol, bytes
| filter (dstPort = 3001 or dstPort = 27017) and action = "ACCEPT"
| filter not (srcAddr like /^127\./ or srcAddr like /^10\./ or srcAddr like /^192\.168\./ or srcAddr like /^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./)
| stats count(*) as flows, sum(bytes) as totalBytes by srcAddr, dstAddr, dstPort
| sort flows desc

2801.def:

| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName =~ "firefox.exe"
| where FolderPath has "Tor Browser" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "Tor Browser"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Ver = ProcessVersionInfoProductVersion

2802.sigma:
title: Firefox Renderer Content Process Spawning Unexpected Child
id: 5f2a1c94-7b6e-4a2d-9e3f-1c8d0a4b7e21
description: A Firefox content/renderer process (firefox.exe with -contentproc) spawns a non-Firefox child, indicating code execution inside the sandboxed renderer consistent with CVE-2026-10702 (IonStack stage 1).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/researchers-show-single-malicious.html
  - https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-54/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/29
tags:
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1068
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\firefox.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: '-contentproc'
  filter_helpers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\plugin-container.exe'
      - '\updater.exe'
      - '\crashreporter.exe'
      - '\pingsender.exe'
      - '\minidump-analyzer.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_helpers
level: high
2802.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="firefox.exe" Processes.parent_process="*-contentproc*" NOT Processes.process_name IN ("firefox.exe","plugin-container.exe","updater.exe","crashreporter.exe","pingsender.exe","minidump-analyzer.exe") by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process, Processes.process_name, Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
2802.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe) @ParentCommandLine:*-contentproc* -@Image:(*\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\plugin-container.exe OR *\updater.exe OR *\crashreporter.exe OR *\pingsender.exe)
2802.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/firefox\.exe$/i
| regex("-contentproc", field=ParentCommandLine)
| NOT (ImageFileName=/(firefox|plugin-container|updater|crashreporter|pingsender|minidump-analyzer)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2806.sent:
let lookback = 30d;
let window = 6h;
let Logins = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where DeviceVendor has "Check Point"
    | where Activity has_any ("Log In","Login","Administrator Login") or Message has_any ("SmartConsole","login token","SSO ticket")
    | where isnotempty(SourceIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(SourceIP))
    | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, Admin = DestinationHostName, SourceIP, MgmtHost = DestinationHostName;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where DeviceVendor has "Check Point"
| where Activity has_any ("Install Policy","Policy Installation","Save Policy","Publish","Modify Object","Create Object","Delete Object") or Message has_any ("install policy","policy installation","rulebase","access-rule")
| project ChangeTime = TimeGenerated, Admin = DestinationHostName, ChangeActivity = Activity, ChangeMsg = Message, MgmtHost = DestinationHostName
| join kind=inner Logins on Admin
| where ChangeTime between (LoginTime .. LoginTime + window)
| project LoginTime, ChangeTime, MinutesAfterLogin = datetime_diff('minute', ChangeTime, LoginTime), Admin, SourceIP, ChangeActivity, ChangeMsg, MgmtHost
| sort by ChangeTime desc
2806.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.vendor_product="Check Point*" AND (All_Changes.action IN ("modified","created","deleted") OR All_Changes.object_category="firewall_rule") by All_Changes.user, All_Changes.src, All_Changes.action, All_Changes.object, All_Changes.command | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | sort - lastTime

id: 9d3f7b52-1a6c-4e88-b0d9-2c4a6e8f1b33
description: POST to a NodeBB ActivityPub inbox whose body carries an actor/object id containing HTML-breakout characters, stored unescaped into the admin Federation Errors view
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/eight-high-severity-vulnerabilities-nodebb
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/22
tags:
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    cs-uri-stem|endswith: '/inbox'
  payload:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - 'onerror'
      - '<img'
      - '%22%3E'
  condition: selection and payload
level: medium

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("svcmgmt.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("svcmgmt.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

title: WordPress wp2shell SQL Injection via author__not_in Parameter (CVE-2026-60137)
id: 8f2c1a44-3e5d-4b6a-9c2f-1a7b9d0e4c11
description: Detects SQL-injection content in the WordPress REST author__not_in parameter, which normally only accepts integer post-author IDs. Core signature of the wp2shell pre-auth RCE chain.
references:
  - https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/etr-cve-2026-63030-wp2shell-a-critical-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-in-wordpress-core/
  - https://www.tenable.com/blog/wp2shell-cve-2026-63030-cve-2026-60137-frequently-asked-questions-about-remote-code-execution
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/22
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_param:
    cs-uri-query|contains: 'author__not_in'
  selection_sqli:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - "'"
      - '%27'
      - 'union'
      - 'select'
      - 'sleep'
      - 'information_schema'
      - '0x'
      - '--'
      - '/*'
  condition: selection_param and selection_sqli

| extend ArtifactName = extract(@"[?&]artifactName=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
